<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ui_script"><sys_ui_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><description/><global>false</global><ignore_in_now_experience>false</ignore_in_now_experience><name>x_2206701_hotel_0.Hotel Portal Auto Redi</name><script><![CDATA[addLoadEvent(function() {
    // Check if the user is logged in
    var userID = g_user.userID;
    if (userID) {
        // Check if the user has the hotel registered user role
        var hasHotelRole = g_user.hasRole('x_2206701_hotel_0.registered_user');
        var isAdmin = g_user.hasRole('admin') || g_user.hasRole('itil');
        
        // Ensure we only redirect if they are on a platform/nav page and NOT already in the portal
        var currentPath = window.location.pathname;
        var alreadyRedirected = sessionStorage.getItem('hotel_global_redirected');
        
        if (hasHotelRole && !isAdmin && currentPath.indexOf('/sp') === -1 && !alreadyRedirected) {
            // Set session storage flag to prevent infinite loops
            sessionStorage.setItem('hotel_global_redirected', 'true');
            
            // Automatically glide them straight into the Service Portal homepage
            window.location.href = '/sp?id=hotel_reservation_home_page';
        }
    }
});]]></script><script_name>Hotel Portal Auto Redirect</script_name><sys_class_name>sys_ui_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-17 13:17:21</sys_created_on><sys_id>55d1322e83a09310e87256d6feaad330</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2206701_hotel_0.Hotel Portal Auto Redi</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Hotel Reservation System" source="x_2206701_hotel_0">ad3f6f23837387d0ef22b1b6feaad323</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Hotel Reservation System">ad3f6f23837387d0ef22b1b6feaad323</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ui_script_55d1322e83a09310e87256d6feaad330</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-17 13:17:21</sys_updated_on><ui_type>0</ui_type><use_scoped_format>false</use_scoped_format></sys_ui_script></record_update>
